affected_region.camera: left side, large truck parked near the ego vehicle
affected_region.isometric: multiple overlapping and shifted 3D bounding boxes segmenting a single physical truck point cloud

evidence: Three separate, overlapping bounding boxes are predicted along the length of a single continuous truck point cloud at x≈6m to 14m, y≈4m.
The bounding boxes are shifted relative to each other, creating a redundant and physically impossible overlapping vehicle state in the 3D space.
This signature is consistent with a translation/perturbation attack designed to confuse the detector's regressors along the truck's boundary.
alternatives_ruled_out: Multi-vehicle platoon (the camera shows only one single continuous flatbed/box truck on the left)
